<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"> <sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"> <controller_preset/> <includes/> <macroponent display_value="Records in Certificate Management copy">0d25459633c8c3506c8432a19e5c7bb4</macroponent> <name>OnCSRSelectChange</name> <preset/> <required_translations>[]</required_translations> <script><![CDATA[/** * @param {params} params * @param {api} params.api * @param {any} params.event * @param {any} params.imports * @param {ApiHelpers} params.helpers */ function handler({api, event, helpers, imports}) { /** * Handles CSR option selection change event. * * Updates the renew_payload state with the newly selected CSR option * while preserving existing payload properties. * * @param {Object} event - Event object containing the selected value * @param {Object} event.payload.value - The selected CSR option identifier */
const selection = event.payload.value;
